description: Unified princess data with scores, descriptions, and images

princesses.name: Snow White
princesses.source: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
princesses.description: Oh, darling, you're the ultimate damsel who relies on woodland critters and a poisoned apple to spice up your day—because nothing says 'empowered' like waiting for a kiss from a stranger to wake you from eternal nap time.

princesses.name: Cinderella
princesses.description: Congrats, you're the queen of passive-aggressive chores, scrubbing floors while dreaming of ball gowns and glass slippers—because why seize your own fate when a fairy godmother and a shoe can do all the heavy lifting?

princesses.name: Aurora
princesses.description: Ah, yes, the sleeping beauty who spends most of her story in a coma, courtesy of a cursed spindle—proving that true love's kiss is the ultimate alarm clock for those too 'busy' napping through life's dramas.

princesses.name: Ariel
princesses.description: You're the mermaid who trades her voice for legs and a shot at a prince—because muting yourself for a guy with a fancy boat is totally the pinnacle of underwater feminism, right?

princesses.name: Belle
princesses.description: Bookworm extraordinaire, you fall for a beastly captor while taming his temper tantrums—Stockholm syndrome never looked so intellectual, or so sarcastically sacrificial.

princesses.name: Jasmine
princesses.description: Palace rebel with a tiger sidekick, you sneak out for adventure but still need a magic carpet ride to escape daddy's rules—freedom's just a genie wish away, isn't it, princess?

princesses.name: Pocahontas
princesses.description: Nature's diplomat who dives off waterfalls and chats with trees to broker peace—because nothing screams 'independent' like risking it all for a colonizer with a questionable helmet.

princesses.name: Mulan
princesses.description: Cross-dressing warrior who saves China but still gets credit only after the disguise drops—proving that kicking butt in drag is fine, as long as you end up with a man and a medal.

princesses.name: Tiana
princesses.description: Workaholic frog-kisser who turns dreams into restaurants one beignet at a time—because true ambition means slaving away until a slimy prince shows you the 'magic' of compromise.

princesses.name: Rapunzel
princesses.description: Tower-bound artist with magical hair and a frying pan for defense—escape your kidnapper-mom just to tangle with thieves, because long locks are your only real superpower.

princesses.name: Merida
princesses.description: Archery ace who turns her mom into a bear to dodge an arranged marriage—family therapy via witchcraft, because nothing says 'feminist' like cursing your kin for freedom.

princesses.name: Elsa
princesses.description: Ice queen who freezes her kingdom in a fit of repression, then belts out anthems about letting go—because isolation and blizzards are the chic way to handle family baggage.

princesses.name: Anna
princesses.description: Optimistic klutz who chases her icy sister through snowstorms for a hug—true love means freezing to death for family, because who needs boundaries when you've got eternal winter?

princesses.name: Moana
princesses.description: Ocean-chosen voyager who defies her dad to save the world with a sassy demigod—because restoring a goddess's heart is easier than dealing with island patriarchy.

princesses.name: Raya
princesses.description: Trust-issues warrior princess swinging a sword through a fractured world—collect dragon gems like Pokémon, because betrayal and backstabbing are just part of the family reunion.

princesses.name: Princess Mononoke
princesses.description: Wolf-raised eco-terrorist who stabs gods and humans alike for the forest—nature's vengeance wrapped in fur and fury, because harmony means biting the hand that pollutes.

princesses.name: Nausicaä
princesses.source: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
princesses.description: Post-apocalyptic glider girl who chats with giant bugs to stop wars—pacifism in a toxic jungle, proving that empathy wins, even if it means getting swallowed by ohmu slime.

princesses.name: Kaguya
princesses.source: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
princesses.description: Moon-bound bamboo baby who toys with suitors and rejects earthly life—celestial snobbery at its finest, because why settle for mortal drama when you can ghost back to the stars?

princesses.name: Princess Fiona
princesses.description: Wedding dress warrior who kicks ass and chooses swamp life over castle luxury—because true love means embracing your inner green monster and roundhouse-kicking societal expectations into the mud.

princesses.name: Princess Anastasia
princesses.description: Amnesiac Russian royal who escapes revolution with a conman and a bat sidekick—because overthrowing the Bolsheviks is easier when you've got musical numbers and a mysterious past to guide you through Paris.
